# LanguageCert

> LanguageCert is an Ofqual-recognized provider of CEFR-aligned language exams and certifications, including UKVI-approved SELT for UK visa and immigration requirements.

LanguageCert offers a comprehensive suite of language proficiency assessments across English, Spanish, and Classical Greek, serving learners from young students to professionals. The organization operates a global network of test centers and partners with educational institutions and employers worldwide.

## Key Topics

- CEFR levels
- UKVI SELT
- English ESOL
- Language certification

## Core Exams & Certifications

- [LanguageCert Language Exams & Certifications](https://www.languagecert.org/en): LanguageCert homepage: UKVI-approved language exams and certifications
- [Explore all language Exams](https://www.languagecert.org/en/explore-languagecert-exams): LanguageCert exam overview: CEFR-aligned English, Spanish, and more
- [LANGUAGECERT SELT for UKVI](https://www.languagecert.org/en/language-exams/english/languagecert-esol-selt): LanguageCert SELT for UKVI: UK visa and immigration requirements
- [International ESOL - English Exams](https://www.languagecert.org/en/language-exams/english/languagecert-international-esol): LanguageCert International ESOL: CEFR-aligned English certification
- [LANGUAGECERT ESOL For Schools](https://www.languagecert.org/en/language-exams/english/languagecert-esol-for-schools): LanguageCert ESOL for Schools: CEFR-aligned exam for youth learners
- [Young Learners ESOL English Exams](https://www.languagecert.org/en/language-exams/english/languagecert-young-learners-esol): LanguageCert Young Learners ESOL: English assessment for children
- [LanguageCert Test of English (LTE)](https://www.languagecert.org/en/language-exams/english/languagecert-test-of-english-lte): LanguageCert LTE: Workplace English and international certification
